messages:
diego_ae: Quick sync — MerchantCo RFP landed. They want a capability matrix, answered security questionnaire, and a 2-week POC plan with cost estimates. I started a draft doc: https://docs.google.com/merchant-rfp-draft (please add comments).

marta_se: on it. can you drop the security questionnaire PDF? also what's the expected throughput?

diego_ae: Uploading sec q now (merchant_sec_q_v1.pdf). Throughput target: 200 req/s peak, 20k tokens/min. They'll test embeddings and chat gen. Also they'd like dedicated capacity option.

asha_pm: For POC: propose 2 phases — Phase A (integration + baseline tests, 1 week), Phase B (scale and regression monitoring, 1 week). Need contact to onboard infra. I'll draft acceptance criteria.

ben_security: skimmed Q. A few answers need legal signoff (data residency, KMS). I'll flag items 6,9,12. Also we need to confirm SOC2 attestation copy.

olivia_legal: I can attach the SOC2 summary. Also need to confirm contractual language for data processing and sub processors. Will prepare redlines.

marta_se: attaching capability matrix snippet for review:

```
Feature,Supported,Notes
Hosted API,Yes,Streaming + tools
Dedicated,Yes,SLA-backed slots
Private (VPC),Partial,On-prem package requires SOW
KV caching,Yes,Prefix caching opt-in
Quantized models,Yes,recommend int8
```

Thoughts?

ben_security: In matrix, change Private (VPC) to 'Yes (VPC only)'; on-prem has additional compliance steps. Also add 'Encryption at rest: KMS/HSM' row.

diego_ae: updated doc link: https://docs.google.com/merchant-rfp-draft#matrix . I'm going to fill pricing tiers. Need rough numbers for 2-week POC: dedicated dev pool (4xA100 equiv) + support hours.

asha_pm: estimate: POC infra ~ $12k (reserved infra + bastion/provisioning), SE time ~ 24h (discounted), onboarding setup fee waived for deal > $100k MRR. Flagging for pricing review.

marta_se: @olivia_legal and @ben_security can we get signoff on the answers to Q6/Q12 by EOD? merchant's RFP due by Friday COB.

ben_security: I'll review answers tonight. if no blockers I'll sign off by 1800 PST.

olivia_legal: I'll aim for 1900 PST — will send redlines to the doc.

eval-bot: automated note: added eval checklist template to doc (merchant_eval_checklist.md).

diego_ae: thanks all. next steps: Marta to finalize matrix, Ben/Olivia sign answers, Asha to publish POC SOW draft. I'll ping procurement for pricing approval.
